thread:
maria.p: Quick check for tomorrow's deploy — can someone confirm the TLS cipher suites we're advertising on public endpoints (api.redwood.com, console.redwood.com) and who owns the KMS keys used for DB disk encryption? Need compliance sign-off.

kevin: Which public endpoints are we checking — ALB in front of api/console or the nginx layer? Also do you want us to include the dedicated endpoints in us-west-2?

maria.p: Priority is ALB in front of api/console (prod). Please include the dedicated endpoints in us-west-2 if it's quick, but public first.

sre-oncall: Quick probe results from my laptop:```
openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.com:443 -servername api.redwood.com
CONNECTED(00000003)
Protocol  : TLSv1.3
Cipher    : TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
ALPN      : h2,http/1.1
---
Acceptable client certificate types: RSA
---
```Supported server ciphers observed: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 (TLS1.3)
For TLS1.2 the ALB offers: ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256. No RC4/3DES.

security-bot: Scheduled scanner report: https://internal.redwood/reports/scan-2026-03-14 — public endpoints flagged as "modern" policy (TLS1.3 + TLS1.2 strong ciphers). No critical issues.

ryan: Confirming ALB config: we're on a custom policy derived from ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2023. TLS1.3 is enabled cluster-wide. We haven't explicitly disabled TLS1.2 because some legacy clients still connect, but TLS1.2 only allows ECDHE suites.

maria.p: Good to know. Now KMS: who is the owner for the production disk encryption keys and what's the alias?

kms-admin: Owner is platform-keys-team (platform-keys@redwood). Primary alias: `alias/rw-prod-db`. Key ID `1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab`. Automatic rotation is enabled.

maria.p: Thanks. Who can approve temporary read access for the audit team to fetch key metadata? Need a 1-hour window.

kevin: I can approve. Please open an access request ticket in #access-requests with the JIRA ID and tag me. Include exact IAM principal and justification.

maria.p: Created ticket RW-2147 in #access-requests and tagged @kevin. Request: read-only key metadata for `alias/rw-prod-db`, 1 hour.

kevin: Approved and granted — temporary IAM role attached, expires in 1 hour. Audit team confirmed they can call `aws kms describe-key --key-id 1234abcd...`. :lock:

maria.p: Perfect. One follow-up: can we add the TLS cipher list and ALB policy name to the security runbook so next compliance check is faster?

ryan: Will add the policy name and `openssl` snippet to the runbook in docs/infrastructure/networking by EOD.

maria.p: Awesome, thanks everyone — closing this check. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Automated note: remember to attach the access request ticket to the audit evidence in the compliance workspace.
